name: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park
description: At the foot of Pavagadh Hill in Gujarat, western India, Champaner was a Hindu city founded in the 8th century and later the 16th-century capital of a Muslim sultanate. Mosques, tombs, gateways, palaces and stepwells lie scattered across the landscape, still largely unexcavated. Pilgrims climb the 800-metre hill to the Kalika Mata Temple, which keeps the site a living place of worship.
